reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs support it: § 6(b) and § 7(c) limit Customer's post-termination exposure to fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the termination date, with no minimum fee, early-termination fee, or stipulated damages.
Section 3(a) compensation is purely time-and-materials plus actual expenses, with no penalty, late-payment interest, or liquidated amount payable by Company (the Customer).
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged and no comment was added, which is correct here.
Deterministic checks returned no issues, consistent with a no-edit compliant finding.
